quick.caption: A short message to the people at your event. In-app and push only.

toast.sent: Your message is on its way.

error.held: This message was held for review.

confirm.title: Send this message?
confirm.subject: Subject: {{subject}}
confirm.body: This goes to {{audience}} now, in the app and as a push notification. It cannot be unsent.

list.title: Messages
list.hint: civfix relays your message. You never see an attendee's address, and they can unsubscribe from any of them.
list.empty_body: Send an update, a reminder or a thank-you to the people who signed up.

composer.subject: Subject
composer.body_hint: Bold, italics, links and lists only. Links must be https.

composer.schedule_not_in_zone: That time does not exist in {{zone}} because the clocks change. Pick another time.
composer.schedule_zone_hint: Sends at this time in the event's time zone ({{zone}}).

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.privacy_note: Deliveries record only whether a message went out. civfix stores no address and no copy of the body here, and anyone who unsubscribed never appears in this list.
deliveries.empty_body: Deliveries appear once the message starts sending.

send_confirm.title: Send this message?
send_confirm.body: It goes to {{count}} people and cannot be recalled.
send_confirm.banner: Every recipient can unsubscribe from your messages after this one.
send_confirm.agreement: I have read the message and want to send it now.

cancel_confirm.title: Cancel this message?
cancel_confirm.banner: Remaining deliveries are stopped and recorded as suppressed.
